mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orders ( order_id, product_amount, shipping_fee, discount_amount, total_amount, order_status, created_at, created_by, modified_at, modified_by ) VALUES ( #{orderId}, #{productAmount}, #{shippingFee}, #{discountAmount}, #{totalAmount}, #{orderStatus}, #{createdAt}, #{createdBy}, #{modifiedAt}, #{modifiedBy} )

INSERT INTO order_items ( order_id, product_id, product_name, product_thumbnail_url, category_name, product_variant_id, option_name, option_price, quantity, is_required ) VALUES
( #{createOrderItem.orderId}, #{createOrderItem.productId}, #{createOrderItem.productName}, #{createOrderItem.productThumbnailUrl}, #{createOrderItem.categoryName}, #{createOrderItem.productVariantId}, #{createOrderItem.optionName}, #{createOrderItem.optionPrice}, #{createOrderItem.quantity}, #{createOrderItem.isRequired} )
mapper.select: SELECT order_id, product_amount, shipping_fee, discount_amount, total_amount, order_status, sender_name, sender_phone, recipient_name, recipient_phone, zonecode, road_address, detail_address, delivery_request, delivery_request_detail FROM orders WHERE order_id = #{orderId}
